description: This Java class 'CompoundInterestHelper' contains methods for calculating compound interest over multiple posting periods in a financial application, specifically within the Apache Fineract project. It manages calculations such as interest accumulation, considering factors like account lock periods and interest transfer flags.

classes.name: CompoundInterestHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing logic to calculate compound interest across multiple posting periods, considering account states and interest transfer policies.

methods.name: calculateInterestForAllPostingPeriods
methods.description: Calculates the total interest earned for a list of posting periods, taking into account account lock periods, interest transfer settings, and previous interest accumulation.
